Official 66°North product-page Size Guide, Men's Snæfell Technostretch Jacket (same chart)

audit: Old /en-gb/size-guide 404s; no standalone guide on 66north.com. Product-page Size Guide on two men's items (fleece and jacket) prints the same chart in cm (IN tab also), XS-3XL, with chest, waist, hip, sleeve and inseam (inseam on a jacket chart = body sizes). XS 86/72 -> 90/72; M 98/84 -> 102/84; XXL 117/103 -> 2XL 120/102. Hip added; 3XL added; XXL relabelled 2XL as printed. UK/US/EU removed (not printed; old 'UK 34'/'EU 44' were conventions).
